messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 196

Enable 1. Press ON to enable power. Status changes to Robot Active Backdrive 2. Press and hold Freedrive. Status changes to Backdrive Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. 3. Move robot as in Freedrive mode. Joint brakes are released where needed once the Freedrive button is activated. NOTICE In Backdrive Mode the robot is “heavy” to move around. MANDATORY ACTION You must test Backdrive mode on all joints. Safety Verify the robot safety settings comply with the robot installation risk assessment. settings Additional safety inputs Check which safety inputs and outputs are active and that they can be triggered via and outputs PolyScope or external devices. are still functioning UR5e 199 User Manual

Robot | statusChangesTo | Backdrive | after pressing ON to enable power and pressing and holding Freedrive | Status changes to Backdrive
Joint brakes | areReleased | where needed | once the Freedrive button is activated | Joint brakes are released where needed once the Freedrive button is activated.
Robot in Backdrive Mode | isHeavyToMove | true | | In Backdrive Mode the robot is “heavy” to move around.
Operator | mustTest | Backdrive mode on all joints | | You must test Backdrive mode on all joints.
Robot safety settings | mustComply | robot installation risk assessment | | Verify the robot safety settings comply with the robot installation risk assessment.
Safety inputs and outputs | mustBeVerified | active and triggerable via PolyScope or external devices | | Check which safety inputs and outputs are active and that they can be triggered via PolyScope or external devices.
Additional safety inputs and outputs | mustStillFunction | true | | Additional safety inputs and outputs are still functioning
